# portainer_motd (Data Source)

The `portainer_motd` data source reads Portainer's message of the day — the banner shown to users after they log in.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "portainer_motd" "this" {}

output "portainer_announcement" {
  value = data.portainer_motd.this.message
}
```

## Arguments Reference

This data source takes no arguments.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hash` (String) Hash of the message, which the UI uses to remember that a user has dismissed this particular one. Changes whenever the message changes.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `message` (String) Body of the message of the day.
- `style` (String) Inline CSS Portainer's UI applies to the message.
- `title` (String) Title of the message of the day, empty when Portainer is serving none.
